requirement: The system shall provide a Flutter/Dart Home Recipes client that runs on Android, iOS, Web, and macOS.

The system shall use a Go gRPC backend and a shared Protocol Buffers service definition for compatible communication among the client, server, and gateway. A gRPC-Gateway shall make the supported recipe and ingredient operations available over HTTP and translate requests to the corresponding backend operations; when recipe listing uses server streaming, it shall preserve the streaming response.

The system shall allow users to add recipes and receive an indication of whether the addition succeeded, list all recipes, view ingredients available at home, and retrieve the ingredients for a selected recipe.

The server shall support local execution, Docker container deployment, deployment to a local Kubernetes cluster, and deployment to Azure Kubernetes Service using the corresponding deployment configuration.
